newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares continue bull run, surge 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares continue bull run, surge 4.5 pct.

text.p: Slovenian shares on Friday added on to this year's heady gains, jumping 4.53 percent on what traders said appeared to be insatiable foreign demand.
Traders confident bull run to continue over the medium term as foreign buying has triggered catch-up buying from domestic investors.
"This is a madhouse -- all shares are going up and...it seems like foreign investors still feel prices are low," said Goran Brankovic, a trader at Nova Ljubljanska banka.
* Food company Kolinska was the most actively traded, jumping 6.96 percent to 2,460 tolars on volume of 80,387 shares.
* Overall 15 shares rose, one was unchanged, two fell and seven were untraded.
